title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
description: The Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles are back in an all-new animated series on Nickelodeon! Surfacing topside for the first time on their fifteenth birthday, the titular turtles, Leonardo, Michelangelo, Raphael and Donatello, find that life out of the sewers isn’t exactly what they thought it would be. Now the turtles must work together as a team to take on new enemies that arise to take over New York City.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x1
episodes_data.description: For fifteen years, four mutant Turtles and their rodent sensei have lived a secret life beneath the sewers of New York. Coming to the surface for the first time, the Turtles soon find their day out interrupted as a young girl and her father become the targets of mysterious, and dangerous, men...

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x2
episodes_data.description: When April O'Neil is abducted, the Turtles search leads to the base of the robotic Kraang army, and Leonardo struggles to unify his rebellious brothers to victory.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x3
episodes_data.description: The Turtles are in danger of exposure when hot-headed Raphael is caught on video arguing with a human on the street. He must learn to control his temper in order to help the others retrieve the video before it falls into the wrong hands.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x4
episodes_data.description: To prove that Turtles can be friends with humans, Michelangelo uses a social networking site to befriend a famous martial artist who is secretly Shredder's top lieutenant.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x5
episodes_data.description: When Donatello's latest invention gives failed inventor and perpetual loser Baxter Stockman enhanced abilities, the turtles must learn to use their heads instead of brute force to defeat him.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x6
episodes_data.description: When Donatello loses confidence in his bo staff as an effective weapon, he constructs Metalhead, a fully armed robotic turtle based on Kraang technology.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x7
episodes_data.description: Donatello and April investigate a scientist’s disappearance, but discover a conspiracy regarding a bizarre psychic monkey instead.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x8
episodes_data.description: Leo fears his act of mercy has come back to haunt him when Xever holds a local noodle shop owner hostage.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x9
episodes_data.description: After April receives a warning from her imprisoned father, she and the Turtles embark on a mission to save him and stop The Kraang from detonating a mutagen bomb in the city.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x10
episodes_data.description: The Turtles must defend their home in the sewers when Chris Bradford tries to destroy it with a dangerous chemical.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x11
episodes_data.description: When simultaneous threats from the Purple Dragons and Baxter Stockman’s mechanical Mousers force the Turtles to split into two groups, Donnie & Mikey must prove that their “B Team” is just as valuable as Leo & Raph’s “A Team.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x12
episodes_data.description: Michelangelo befriends Leatherhead, an unstable mutant alligator who possesses a strange piece of Kraang technology, but the other Turtles aren’t sure whether Leatherhead is a friend or a foe.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x13
episodes_data.description: The Turtles must face off against a new enemy, The Rat King, who threatens not only to take control of the city, but of Splinter's mind as well.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x14
episodes_data.description: Snakeweed returns and begins abducting people. Tired of Raphael's constant criticism while trying to stop Snakeweed, Leonardo lets Raphael try his hand at leadership. While away from the group, Leonardo meets a female Foot Ninja named Karai, who tries to lure him to the dark side.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x15
episodes_data.description: The Turtles get their first look at high school when April's school project draws attention from the Kraang.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x16
episodes_data.description: The Turtles meet their first fan when a teenager decides to dress up and fight crime as "The Pulverizer.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x17
episodes_data.description: While breaking into the hostile environment of TCRI headquarters, the Turtles discover the true intent of the Kraang and resolve to stop the alien invasion once and for all.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x18
episodes_data.description: While trying to foil a Kraang invasion plot, the Turtles are hunted by a giant cockroach.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x19
episodes_data.description: Baxter Stockman seeks revenge on Fishface and Dogpound as well as the Turtles, and lures them all into a deadly labyrinth.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x20
episodes_data.description: After witnessing the Kraang in action, Karai realizes the seriousness of the alien threat and proposes an alliance with the Turtles....unless the Shredder finds out.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x21
episodes_data.description: While the Turtles are infiltrating an undersea Kraang base, the Foot Clan attempts to capture April.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x22
episodes_data.description: When Shredder plans to create an army of mutants, the Turtles must rely on the help of the Pulverizer, who was recruited into the Foot (to be expendable) and volunteers to gather information on the inside on their behalf. When he agrees to be a test subject for a stolen supply of Kraang Mutagen, the Turtles rescue him, but not before he recklessly gets himself mutated.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x23
episodes_data.description: Michaelangelo must fight his brothers when they fall under the control of a parasitic wasp.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x24
episodes_data.description: Donatello breaks into a secret Kraang detention center in order to rescue Kirby O'Neil, but ends up trapped inside with a deadly prisoner called the Newtralizer.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x25
episodes_data.description: The turtles engage in a difficult battle, as they make a desperate assault on TCRI to shut down the Kraang portal.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 1x26
episodes_data.description: With the world at stake, the only thing of importance is that the Turtles complete their mission. No matter what ...

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2x1
episodes_data.description: The Turtles discover that the Kraang survived their previous showdown and have dropped mutagen canisters all over New York City.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2x2
episodes_data.description: While tracking mutagen, the Turtles bring a mutated squirrel back to the lair. When it starts multiplying, the Turtles must hunt the squirrel mutants and prevent them from escaping into the city.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2x3
episodes_data.description: The Turtles face an army of robot foot soldiers; Karai captures Leonardo and forces him to do battle with ninjas that can adapt to his every move.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2x4
episodes_data.description: Donatello experiments with mutagen in an attempt to find a cure for April's mutated father. But one of his expirements goes wrong and he is unleashed in the city.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2x5
episodes_data.description: Michelangelo plays with some mutagen, contracting a dangerous infection that mutates out of control.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2x6
episodes_data.description: April tries to resume her normal life; April realizes that she may have put her friend in jeopardy when Karai starts hunting her again.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2x7
episodes_data.description: The Turtles find themselves being hunted by a new threat -- another mutant turtle called Slash, who has a personal vendetta against the brothers.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2x8
episodes_data.description: After encountering mutants and ninjas, Casey Jones decides to take on "pure evil" alone. When he meets Raphael, the two hot-headed fighters must put their dislike for each other aside and work together against a common foe.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2x9
episodes_data.description: April feels left out and insists on joining the Turtles on a mission to TCRI; A secret about April's past is revealed...

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2x10
episodes_data.description: A fungus mutant spreads through the sewers causing the Turtles to experience their worst fears. Leonardo must face his greatest fear.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2x11
episodes_data.description: After Donnie upgrades Metalhead's artificial intelligence, he must decide if he can trust a sentient Metalhead.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2x12
episodes_data.description: When the Rat King returns, Splinter must overcome his fears in order to defeat his enemy.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2x13
episodes_data.description: Leonardo considers asking Splinter for help while facing Shredder's new assassin; Donnie must put aside his rivalry with Casey in order to uncover a Kraang plot.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2x14
episodes_data.description: Leonardo considers asking Splinter for help while facing Shredder's new assassin; Donnie must put aside his rivalry with Casey in order to uncover a Kraang plot.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2x15
episodes_data.description: When the turtles play a Fantasy LARP game to get their minds off things, they separate the difference between fantasy and reality.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2x16
episodes_data.description: The Turtles create a retro-mutagen to help April's father; Baxter Stockman threatens to mutate April.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2x17
episodes_data.description: Raphael is worried about Casey's ability to handle big mutant threats especially when they meet Slash again and discover he has a partner of his own, the Newtralizer.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2x18
episodes_data.description: Mikey struggles to convince the others that a new mutant is trying to attack and capture people using living pizzas.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2x19
episodes_data.description: When Tiger Claw returns, he vows to hunt and destroy the turtles, as well as April and Casey. Meanwhile, Karai finds out the truth about her mother and real father, forcing her to make a life changing decision.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2x20
episodes_data.description:
Leo tries to convince the team to rescue Karai; a master thief steals Shredder’s helmet.

("Kuro Kabuto" means "Black Helmet" in Japanese. )

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2x21
episodes_data.description: Raphael accidentally damages a machine that forces him to swap minds with a Kraang.  Now he must find a way to convince his brothers and Splinter that it's really him, before the Kraang controlling his body destroys his brothers or worse, reveals their location to the rest of the Kraang.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2x22
episodes_data.description: Leo stages a rescue for Karai against Splinter's wishes. While the mission is a success, Karai's knowledge of the truth makes her rush out to take her revenge on Shredder for killing her mother and lying to her for so long, leading to an unexpected turn of events.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2x23
episodes_data.description: Donnie becomes increasingly jealous of April and Casey's relationship; April is kidnapped by an evil spirit who intends to drain her powers.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2x24
episodes_data.description: When the Turtles go to the bizarre realm of Dimension X, Mikey is the only one who can figure the place out.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2x25
episodes_data.description: Leo and Donnie disagree about their plan to stop the Kraang invasion; Donnie must step up as the leader of the bunch when Leo makes a mistake and is separated from the team.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2x26
episodes_data.description: Leo and Donnie disagree about their plan to stop the Kraang invasion; Donnie must step up as the leader of the bunch when Leo makes a mistake and is separated from the team.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3x1
episodes_data.description: The team tries to deal with the possibility that Leo will not get better; a new mutant captures Raphael.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3x2
episodes_data.description: When the Turtles discover Bigfoot in the woods, Donnie befriends it and insists they protect it from a hunter.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3x3
episodes_data.description: When the guys discover a Kraang ship buried under April's house, they also uncover April's lost mother.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3x4
episodes_data.description: When he gets upset, Mikey flees and befriends a mutant frog in the woods, only to learn the frog and his family have nefarious plans.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3x5
episodes_data.description: When the Turtles are trapped in their dreams by creatures, April and Casey must figure out how to wake them up.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3x6
episodes_data.description: When Casey and Donatello bond while building Casey's new hot rod, the bond is challenged by a hot-rodding mutant.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3x7
episodes_data.description: When Casey, Raph, Mikey and Donnie are captured by a new mutant, April and Leo must overcome disabilities in order to save them.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3x8
episodes_data.description: Leo takes the Turtles to train in the woods in an advanced ninja ritual; the Turtles must overcome their weaknesses and face their enemies to become a true ninja.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3x9
episodes_data.description: When the Turtles return to the city to search for Splinter, they discover that the city has been overrun with Kraang.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3x10
episodes_data.description: As the Turtles search for Karai, they are forced to deal with a city filled with Kraangdroids as well as Zeck and Steranko.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3x11
episodes_data.description: Donnie finishes a new batch of retro-mutagen in hopes of saving Karai; the Turtles are hunted by Shredder's new henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3x12
episodes_data.description: The Turtles must brave the bizarre world of Dimension X to save the enslaved people of New York. Part 1

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3x13
episodes_data.description: Part 2

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3x14
episodes_data.description: Casey Jones thinks he can take on the criminal underworld on his own, but soon discovers that he is in over his head.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3x15
episodes_data.description: A new and unfamiliar mutant known as Muckman begins to gain notoriety as New York City's "Monster Hero."

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3x16
episodes_data.description: The Shredder kidnaps and experiments on the Mighty Mutanimals.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3x17
episodes_data.description: Michelangelo and Casey become friends with Mondo Gecko, a radical, skateboarding, reptilian teenager.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3x18
episodes_data.description: When Karai is brainwashed, she begins hunting the Turtles.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3x19
episodes_data.description: When the Turtles are whisked through time by apprentice Time Master Renet, they all must work together to defeat the evil Time Master Savanti Romero.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3x20
episodes_data.description: When the Turtles are accidentally transported to the past, they happen to cross paths with a familiar ninja clan.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3x21
episodes_data.description: Leonardo decides to sneak into Shredder's lair alone, and winds up facing the biggest mutant threat yet.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3x22
episodes_data.description: After an accident, Donnie finds himself slowly losing his intelligence.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3x23
episodes_data.description: After being kidnapped by the hypnotized Karai, the Turtles are placed in deadly traps that they must work together in in order to escape. Splinter, in his efforts to save the turtles, is forced to face Karai in order to free her from Shredder's control.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3x24
episodes_data.description: Raphael meets a confused alien dinosaur named Zog, the Triceraton.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3x25
episodes_data.description: When the turtles get word of the Kraang's return, they realize there is an even bigger threat coming to Earth.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3x26
episodes_data.description: When the turtles get word of the Kraang's return, they realize there is an even bigger threat coming to Earth.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 4x2
episodes_data.description: The Turtles and their enemy crash-land on an ice moon and they must put aside their differences in order to survive.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 4x3
episodes_data.description: Casey releases a wish-granting alien named Wyrm, who wants his freedom to do whatever he wants to the universe

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 4x4
episodes_data.description: A shark-like bounty hunter is hired by Lord Dregg to destroy the turtles, who choose to hide out in an abandoned space station.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 4x8
episodes_data.description: The Turtles must gain the trust of the Utrom Council in order to find the next piece of the black hole generator.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 4x9
episodes_data.description: The Turtles journey through an ocean-like area of space.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 4x10
episodes_data.description: The Turtles are transported to another dimension where they meet their 1980s counterparts and work together to battle Krang.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 4x11
episodes_data.description: Donatello is feeling inferior to Fugitoid, but his intellect is put to the test when the Triceratons attack.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 4x12
episodes_data.description: When Raphael loses his fighting mojo, he must overcome his feelings to save his brothers from certain doom.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 4x13
episodes_data.description: The team must overcome impossible odds in order to obtain the final Black Hole Generator piece that is located on the planet Magdomar.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 4x16
episodes_data.description: When Leonardo secretly allies himself with Karai, he gets himself into deeper danger than he could have realized.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 4x17
episodes_data.description: Raphael must overcome his fear of insects to lead the team when they are forced to battle Stockman-Fly's new insect minions.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 4x18
episodes_data.description: Don Vizioso's gang tracks the Turtles with a slew of Anti-Mutant weapons.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 4x20
episodes_data.description: For the first time, the Turtles encounter something they cannot defeat – the Super Shredder!

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 4x21
episodes_data.description: The Turtle team hunts for their Sensei, but soon realizes they are being hunted as well.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 4x22
episodes_data.description: Donatello becomes concerned and decides to test April, only to discover that her psychic abilities are rapidly growing in power.

episodes_data.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 4x26
episodes_data.description: With the demise of their beloved father and Karai incapacitated, the Turtles, April, and Casey, infiltrate Super Shredder's new lair to put an end to Oroku Saki once and for all, no matter what it takes.
